RKFORGE ₹640

I shared this around ₹600 back in May.

For almost 90 days, it did absolutely nothing. No excitement. No breakout. Just sideways price action.

This is where most investors lose patience. They get frustrated, exit the stock, and move on.

Now the company has delivered strong Q1 results, management has given bullish growth guidance, the stock has turned green on the weekly chart after 19 months, and it has finally taken out a major monthly supply zone.

The biggest returns rarely come immediately after you buy. They come to those who can sit through the boring phase.

If RKFORGE clears its long-term downtrend, this move could surprise a lot of people.

Sometimes when I buy a stock, Screener shows me the future market cap and PE of the company.
